summary: 공원이나 산림의 큰키나무에서 번식하는 흔한 여름철새로, 전국에서 볼 수 있다. 그다지 높지 않은 가지 위에 밥그릇 모양 둥지를 틀고, 옅은 푸른 바탕에 어두운 갈색 점이 있는 알을 3~5개 낳는다. 큰키나무와 떨기나무의 여러 씨앗과 열매를 주로 먹고 곤충도 먹는다. 세계적으로는 중국, 홍콩, 일본, 라오스, 미얀마, 러시아, 타이완, 태국, 베트남에 분포한다.

points.en: pale orange bill with a black tip
white tips to flight feathers and white primary coverts
pale grey rump and black tail

art.subject: Chinese Grosbeak (Eophona migratoria), adult male in the breeding season, as seen in Korean parks and forests from May to August: glossy blue-black hood covering the whole head, face and chin, cut off cleanly at the nape; hindneck, mantle and back grey-brown; rump pale grey; wings glossy blue-black with white tips to the primaries and white on the primary coverts; breast greyish-buff, flanks warm orange-buff, belly and undertail coverts whitish; tail black and notched. Bill very large and conical, pale orange-yellow with a black tip to both mandibles; iris dark brown; legs pinkish-brown.
art.pose: perched on a branch, eating seeds
art.scene: Korean summer park or forest with tall broadleaf trees; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view perched: black-tipped pale orange-yellow conical bill, glossy black hood and wings, white primary tips and white on the primary coverts, grey-brown nape and back, buff breast with orange-buff flanks, black tail
adult male, back view perched: black hood, grey-brown back, pale grey rump, glossy black wings with white primary tips, black notched tail
adult female, side view perched: no black hood, head and back grey-brown, darker wings with white primary tips, buffy underparts with orange-buff flanks, same black-tipped pale orange-yellow bill
art.build: Stocky, big-headed finch, 17cm, clearly larger than a sparrow, with a large rounded head and thick neck. Bill huge for the bird: deep at the base, conical with a gently curved culmen, nearly as long as the head. Legs short, pinkish-brown. Perches upright in tree canopy and cracks seeds with the heavy bill. At rest the black primaries project beyond the tertials. Tail medium length, black, with a notched tip. In flight the white primary tips form a white trailing edge to the black outer wing.
avoid: Do not paint an all-yellow bill or a white patch in the middle of the primaries; those are Japanese Grosbeak (Eophona personata).
Do not limit the male's black to a cap or face mask; the hood covers the whole head to the nape and chin.
Do not paint a brown-headed Hawfinch with a thick pinkish bill and white tail tip.
Do not give the female the male's black hood.
